name: GET /api/leadflow/offers/feature-matrix - the five labels a rep may speak
description:
The capability matrix, with OWNER AND UPDATE DATE PER CAPABILITY (92ce5959-0e5c-4ce8-be7a-02cc870b2120#AC3). Both are NOT NULL columns, so an entry without them cannot exist - a claim nobody owns is a claim nobody is accountable for, and one nobody can tell is stale is worse than no matrix at all, because it looks authoritative.

FIVE LABELS AND NO OTHERS: LIVE, BETA, ROADMAP, USAGE_THIRD_PARTY, NOT_INCLUDED. A CHECK constraint refuses anything else, which is what stops "it's basically live" reaching a buyer as a commitment. The distinction between USAGE_THIRD_PARTY and NOT_INCLUDED matters commercially: the first is available and billed by somebody else, the second is not available at all, and collapsing them is how a customer discovers a surprise invoice.

by_status is returned so a manager can see at a glance how much of the sheet is ROADMAP - a matrix that is mostly roadmap is a different sales conversation. QA: depends on register and login; offer_key is required.

testCases.name: The matrix returns each capability with its status, owner and update date
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.when: the offer_key query parameter is absent or empty.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
